beats: Unlock YouTube or Spotify with the QR pass and it shut off after half an hour. Any other button, and it could stay open all day if I forgot.
Like one self-closing latch on a door with three others left wide open.
Now every admin button stamps the same timer inside the Cloudflare Worker that guards access.
When it runs out, the normal lock rules take over automatically.
All four unlock paths now expire in thirty minutes, not just one.
